protocol.president.kicker: Presidency of the Republic of Guinea
protocol.president.title: Mr President, the Nation awaits you on the Wall
protocol.president.lede: Your photo and your video message open the Year 68 National Wall. They are published first, as numbers 1 and 2, ahead of every Guinean.
protocol.president.note: Your photo is no. 1 and your video no. 2. A photo or a 10 to 90 second video, with the official frame.
protocol.minister.kicker: Government of the Republic of Guinea
protocol.minister.title: Minister, join the National Wall
protocol.minister.lede: Your selfie or video message is published among the first on the Year 68 National Wall, next to the President of the Republic.
protocol.minister.note: Numbers 11 to 60 of the Wall are reserved for members of the Government. A photo or a 10 to 90 second video, with the official frame.
selfie.videoDurationVip: Measured length: {s} s. The video must last between 10 and 90 seconds.
selfie.protocolDone: Your number on the National Wall
selfie.protocolPending: Your contribution goes to the DCI and is published within minutes.
admin.protocol.title: Presidency and Government
admin.protocol.lede: Contributions received through the Presidency and Government links. They never enter the L1/L2 queues and are never auto-approved. Numbers 1 to 60 are reserved for them: 1 to 10 for the Presidency (no. 1 the President's photo, no. 2 his video), 11 to 60 for the Government.
admin.protocol.legend: Gold: Presidency · Blue: Government · Empty: free. Click a number to open the contribution.
admin.protocol.taken: No. {n} is already held by another contribution. Free it first.
inv.title: Protocol invitations
inv.lede: Nominative QR cards for the parade and the dinner. Create the event, import the Cabinet's list, add photos, issue the cards and download the print PDF. Agents check at guineen68.com/controle.
inv.f.name: Event name
inv.f.codeHint: The code is part of every card's QR and cannot change after creation.
inv.f.intro: Wording after “Le Président de la République”
inv.f.titleLines: Event title on the card (one line per line, 3 at most)
inv.f.verso: Back of the card (access instructions, gates, Protocol contact)
inv.empty: No event yet. Create the parade and the dinner.
inv.pdfHint: The cards PDF is split every {n} cards, one A5 card per page, sorted by zone then name. The back is the same for every card.
inv.importHint: CSV exported from Google Sheets or Excel, or paste the rows below. Recognised columns: civility, first name, last name, title, category, tribune or table, seat, phone. Photos are added afterwards, guest by guest.
inv.photoHint: Recent photo, facing the camera. Never printed: only the agent sees it at the scan.
inv.g.title: Title
gate.title: Invitation control
gate.signin: Sign in with the agent's Google account to start.
gate.noRole: This account is not allowed to check cards. Ask the Cabinet to enable it.
gate.synced: List up to date with the server.
gate.offlineCopy: Local copy: the list comes from the phone's memory.
gate.offline: No network: checking continues, entries will sync later.
gate.prepareHint: Open this page with network before the event: the list and photos stay on the phone.
gate.noCamera: Camera unavailable: type the card's code.
gate.manualHint: Short code printed under the tribune or table, 8 characters.
gate.listHint: For unreadable cards only: admitting from the list requires the identity document.
gate.checkId: No photo on file: ask for the identity document and compare the name.
gate.conflict: Duplicate: {name} had already been admitted at another gate. Tell the supervisor.
